# Capture operations

I start a capture operation on a capturable ship, alone or with my wing. My wingmen break its hull below the bail gate, then only keep its shields down, so the pilot bails instead of dying. Bail pressure and the checks the operation asks for are in bail-pressure.feature.

Source: [`tests/game/features/capture-operation.feature`](../../tests/game/features/capture-operation.feature) · Spec: [`docs/specs/capture-operation.md`](../specs/capture-operation.md)

| Unit tests | Game tests | Manual | Pending | By hand |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 17 | 2 | 4 | **6** |

## Scenarios

### An operation starts on a capturable fighter

**Automated:** in game `capture_start_and_destroyed`

```gherkin
  Given a capturable Imperial fighter with a pilot
  When I start a capture operation on it
  Then the operation starts
```

### An operation can't start on my own ship or twice on the same target

**Automated:** in game `capture_start_and_destroyed`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter
  When I try to start an operation on one of my own ships
  And I try to start a second operation on the same fighter
  Then neither starts
```

### Losing the target ends the operation as destroyed

**Automated:** in game `capture_start_and_destroyed`


### The operation ends when the pilot bails

**Automated:** in game `capture_abandoned`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter
  When the fighter's pilot bails
  Then the operation ends as "abandoned"
  And the fighter is no longer part of an operation
  And no new operation can start on the now ownerless fighter
```

### A wingman stops firing once the target is inside the bail gate

**Automated:** in game `capture_wing_holds_fire`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter with 80% hull and its shields kept down until the hull is below 75%
  And my wingman flies an X-wing with four lasers and no missiles
  When the wingman breaks the fighter's hull below 75%
  Then the wingman stops firing
  And for 30 seconds the hull stays below 75%, and the fighter is never destroyed
  And the hull never drops below the 35% floor
  And the wingman keeps moving while it holds fire, never sitting still for 5 seconds
```

### A wingman starting 2 km out stops the hull near the bail gate

**Automated:** in game `capture_wing_holds_fire_from_2km`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter with 80% hull and its shields kept down until the hull is below 75%
  And my wingman flies an X-wing with four lasers and no missiles, starting 2 km from the fighter and facing it
  When the wingman breaks the fighter's hull below 75%
  Then for 30 seconds the hull stays below 75%, and the fighter is never destroyed
  And the hull never drops below the 35% floor
```

### Only one wingman of a wing finishes the break

**Automated:** in game `capture_wing_holds_fire_three_wingmen`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter with 80% hull and its shields kept down until the hull is below 75%
  And three wingmen fly X-wings with four lasers and no missiles, starting 2 km from the fighter around it
  When the wing breaks the fighter's hull below 75%
  Then only one wingman fires until the hull is below 75%, as the whole break from 80% is inside the wing's margin
  And for 30 seconds the hull stays below 75%, and the fighter is never destroyed
  And the hull never drops below the 35% floor
```

### A turreted wingman's turrets hold fire once the wing is near the bail gate

**Automated:** in game `capture_wing_turrets_hold`, `capture_wing_turrets_hold_m`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter with 80% hull and its shields kept down until the hull is below 75%
  And my wingman flies a <ship> with <guns> and <turrets>, starting 2 km from the fighter and facing it
  When the wing's margin above the gate is used up
  Then its turrets stop firing within a second, through the finish, suppress and hold
  And for 30 seconds the hull stays below 75%, and the fighter is never destroyed
  And the hull never drops below the 35% floor
  And once I cancel its order, each turret is back in the mode it started in
  Examples:
    | ship     | guns                | turrets           |
    | Y-wing   | two KX7 lasers      | an SW4 top turret |
    | YT-1300  | one KX20 laser      | two AG-2G turrets |
```

### Before a release, each wing setup captures in at least 9 runs out of 10

```gherkin
  Then at least 90% of each one's runs hold the hull between the 75% gate and the 35% floor
```


### The mission readout shows the gates, the pilot's nerve and crew aboard

**Automated:** in game `capture_readout`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a crewed ship with full shields and hull, out of the pressure tick's reach
  Then the mission shows "Knock shields below 20%" as step 1 of 3
  When its shields are down
  Then the mission shows "Damage hull below 75%" as step 1
  When its hull is at 50% for 10 seconds
  Then the mission shows "Pilot's nerve" as step 2, with a bar of about 72 of 80
  When one of its crew bails
  Then the mission shows "Crew aboard n/max" with the last check's chance as step 3, with a bar of the crew left
  And a capture operation on a crewless fighter has only the first 2 steps
```
